name: Streaming Ghost Data Generation
aliases: Streaming generation of ghost data for structured grids
Parallel and Streaming Generation of Ghost Data for Structured Grids
Parallel Ghost Data Generation for Structured Grids
definition: An algorithm for generating ghost data for structured grids that uses many fewer processors than previously possible, storing as little as one block per processor in memory and running on as few processors as available (possibly just one).
summary: Streaming Ghost Data Generation is an algorithm that generates boundary values for structured grids by processing blocks sequentially, enabling out-of-core execution with a constant memory footprint.
